prompts.text: Build a 10-second product promo animation as a web page using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, for the product I name or a sample product if I don’t name one, with a dolly in, a rack focus and a whip pan. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when done, check that it plays, and ask before installing or loading anything.
prompts.label: Make a 10-second product promo

action.label: Make a promo with camera moves in Atu

made.alt: A plain perfume shot gives way to three diagrams: dolly in moves the camera closer, rack focus shifts what is sharp, and whip pan swings to a new shot. The same bottle scene then demonstrates all three.
